We also expect selling expenses to increase in the near term as we promote our brand through marketing and advertising initiatives, expand market presence, and hire additional personnel to drive penetration and generate leads.
We expect to derive future liquidity primarily through our revenue from customers and sale of equity securities.
We expect to continue to incur losses, and our ability to achieve and sustain profitability will depend on the achievement of sufficient revenue to support our cost structure.
